_notes: gradeThresholds field is intentionally OMITTED. The Tandon academic-policies bulletin only states a C floor for transfer credit (line 123), not for major-grade counting. Until a Tandon major-specific bulletin or department source establishes a per-major grade floor, degreeAudit's resolveGradeThresholds() will fall through to the CAS defaults (major≥C, core≥D). This is documented behavior, not a silent bug. Track for resolution before Tandon programs are authored.

residency.minCredits: 64 ASSUMES a 128-credit BS program (half = 64). The bulletin (line 111) defines residency as 'at least half of the required credits at Tandon', which for 131-credit Mechanical Engineering is 66 and for 134-credit ECE is 67. When the first non-128-credit Tandon program JSON is authored, replace this static field with a per-program override (or compute residency.minCredits = ceil(program.totalCreditsRequired / 2) at audit time).

_provenance.claim: students must complete a minimum of at least half of the required credits at Tandon in approved Tandon coursework (half of 128 = 64)

Tandon course IDs use the -UY suffix, observed in CP-UY internship designation and MA-UY math course IDs in this bulletin (e.g., MA-UY 914, MA-UY 1024). The Residency Requirement (line 111) defines residency as 'approved Tandon coursework' without naming the suffix.
students must complete their final semester's worth of credits at the University (variable, not a fixed 32)
In regards to Tandon minors, one-half of the coursework must be completed at the NYU Tandon School of Engineering
Students may take a total of 4 courses or 16 credits in other divisions
_provenance.bulletinSection: Coursework in Other Divisions of NYU and Outside Institutions

_provenance.claim: first cross-school minor, study abroad coursework, and courses required for a major at Tandon do not count towards this 4 course/16 credit limit; nor do test credits and prior transfer credits
_provenance.bulletinSection: Coursework in Other Divisions of NYU and Outside Institutions

_provenance.claim: maximum number of credits that can be granted is half of the degree (half of 128 = 64)
_provenance.bulletinSection: Transfer Credits from other Undergraduate Institutions

_provenance.claim: Students cannot elect to change the grading scale of classes to P/F if it is not already set up that way
P/F course will count only as a Free Elective course and in no other way
A grade of P indicates a 'Pass' (equivalent to a D or above) in a P/F graded class
Passing grades in P/F courses do not count towards the GPA. However, F grades received in a P/F graded course will count towards the GPA
Excluded from credit toward the degree are also any courses taken in the School of Professional Studies once a student is matriculated into Tandon
some courses may be double counted towards both majors at the discretion of both academic departments
maximum number of credits that can be granted is half of the degree (half of 128 = 64)
_provenance.bulletinSection: Transfer Credits from other Undergraduate Institutions

_provenance.claim: Undergraduate transfer credit is not given for any course in which a grade less than C or equivalent has been earned. Note: this is a transfer-credit floor, not a per-major grade threshold; gradeThresholds.major is intentionally omitted from this config until a major-specific bulletin source is identified.
_provenance.bulletinSection: Transfer Credits from other Undergraduate Institutions

_provenance.claim: undergraduate students must maintain term and cumulative GPAs of 2.0 or greater

Tandon publishes a per-full-time-semester minimum cumulative GPA: sem 1: 1.501 / 8 credits, sem 2: 1.501 / 16, sem 3: 1.501 / 28, sem 4: 1.67 / 40, sem 5: 1.78 / 56, sem 6: 1.88 / 68, sem 7: 1.95 / 84, >8: 2.00 / 96.
_provenance.bulletinSection: Minimum Credits and Minimum GPA Required by Semester of Full-Time Study (table)

_provenance.claim: Any time a student's cumulative GPA falls below 1.5 they are placed on Final Probation regardless of how many credits they have completed.
_provenance.bulletinSection: Minimum Credits and Minimum GPA — footnote

_provenance.claim: the normal course load for full-time undergraduate students is 14-18 credits
Students placed on academic probation are limited to a maximum of 18 credits per semester while on probation, unless otherwise approved by their adviser
Tandon students may not declare a second major at another NYU School if a similar major, in name and content, is offered at Tandon (e.g., CS, Math)

totalCreditsRequired (128), transferCreditLimits.firstYearMaxTotal (32), goodStandingReturnThreshold (0.67), maxCourseRepeats (2), and advisingContact are NOT explicitly stated in this academic-policies bulletin. They are inherited from CAS-style defaults pending a per-major or NYU-wide bulletin source.

name: Tandon School of Engineering

residency.note: Residency is half the degree credits. Final-semester-in-residence is required but not denominated as a fixed credit count.

passFail.note: Students cannot elect P/F. Only courses already designated P/F are allowed, and they count only as Free Elective credit.

programExclusions.note: Tandon students may not double major at another NYU school in a major similar in name and content to one offered at Tandon (e.g., CS, Math)
